ko.title: 47.8으로 하락: 인플레이션 공포가 4개월 만에 최고치를 기록하며 소비자 심리 위축

segments.src: ## A Second Straight Month of Decline
segments.tr: ## 2개월 연속 하락세

segments.src: American consumers are feeling noticeably gloomier about the economy.
segments.tr: 미국 소비자들은 경제에 대해 눈에 띄게 비관적인 감정을 느끼고 있습니다.

segments.src: The University of Michigan's closely watched Consumer Sentiment Index slid for a second consecutive month, landing at 47.8 — a level that sits just above the all-time lows recorded in recent history.
segments.tr: 미시간 대학교의 소비자 심리지수(Consumer Sentiment Index)가 2개월 연속 하락하여 47.8을 기록했는데, 이는 최근 역사상 기록된 사상 최저치 바로 위에 머무는 수준입니다.

segments.src: The reading is more than a statistical curiosity: it's one of the earliest signals economists use to gauge how households are likely to spend, save, and borrow in the months ahead.
segments.tr: 이 수치는 단순한 통계적 호기심 이상의 의미를 지닙니다. 이는 경제학자들이 향후 몇 달 동안 가계가 소비, 저축, 대출을 어떻게 할지 가늠하기 위해 사용하는 가장 초기 신호 중 하나이기 때문입니다.

segments.src: Unlike hard economic data such as jobs reports or GDP figures, sentiment surveys capture something harder to quantify — how people *feel* about their financial future.
segments.tr: 고용 보고서나 GDP 수치와 같은 경직된 경제 데이터와 달리, 심리 조사는 정량화하기 어려운 것, 즉 사람들이 자신의 재정적 미래에 대해 어떻게 *느끼는지*를 포착합니다.

segments.src: And right now, that feeling is decidedly uneasy.
segments.tr: 그리고 현재 그 느낌은 확실히 불안합니다.

segments.src: ## Inflation Expectations Jump to 4.6%
segments.tr: ## 인플레이션 기대치 4.6%로 급등

segments.src: The headline number that's drawing the most attention from economists is the survey's measure of year-ahead inflation expectations, which climbed to 4.6% — the highest level in four months.
segments.tr: 경제학자들의 가장 큰 주목을 받는 헤드라인 수치는 1년 후 인플레이션 기대치에 대한 설문조사 결과로, 이는 4.6%까지 상승하여 4개월 만에 최고치를 기록했습니다.

segments.src: That's a meaningful jump, and it matters because expectations can become self-fulfilling: when households believe prices will keep rising, they often adjust their behavior in ways that reinforce the trend, from accelerating big-ticket purchases to demanding higher wages.
segments.tr: 이는 의미 있는 급등이며, 기대치가 자기실현적 예언이 될 수 있기 때문에 중요합니다. 가계가 물가가 계속 오를 것이라고 믿으면, 고가의 구매를 앞당기거나 더 높은 임금을 요구하는 등 그 추세를 강화하는 방식으로 행동을 조정하는 경우가 많기 때문입니다.

segments.src: Several forces appear to be feeding this anxiety:
segments.tr: 이러한 불안감을 부추기는 몇 가지 요인이 있는 것으로 보입니다:

segments.src: - **Rising fuel prices** have pushed a highly visible, frequently purchased good back into the spotlight. Gas prices tend to have an outsized psychological effect on consumers because they're updated daily on street corners across the country, making them a constant reminder of inflation even when other prices are more stable.
segments.tr: - **유가 상승**은 눈에 잘 띄고 자주 구매하는 상품을 다시 주목받게 만들었습니다. 휘발유 가격은 전국 거리 곳곳에서 매일 업데이트되기 때문에 소비자에게 심리적으로 큰 영향을 미치는 경향이 있으며, 다른 물가가 더 안정적일 때조차 인플레이션을 끊임없이 상기시키는 역할을 합니다.

segments.src: - **Ongoing trade tensions** have added a layer of uncertainty about the cost of imported goods, components, and materials. Businesses facing higher input costs from tariffs or supply-chain friction often pass at least part of that expense on to consumers, and households appear to be pricing in that risk.
segments.tr: - **지속되는 무역 긴장**은 수입품, 부품 및 원자재 비용에 대한 불확실성을 가중시켰습니다. 관세나 공급망 마찰로 인해 더 높은 투입 비용에 직면한 기업들은 종종 그 비용의 일부를 소비자에게 전가하며, 가계는 이러한 위험을 가격에 반영하고 있는 것으로 보입니다.

segments.src: - **Broader economic uncertainty**, including questions about the labor market and interest rates, has compounded the sense that the near-term outlook is unsettled.
segments.tr: - **광범위한 경제적 불확실성**은 노동 시장과 금리에 대한 의문을 포함하여, 단기 전망이 불안정하다는 인식을 심화시켰습니다.

segments.src: ## Why This Reading Matters
segments.tr: ## 이 수치가 중요한 이유

segments.src: Consumer spending accounts for roughly two-thirds of U.S.
segments.tr: 소비 지출은 미국 경제 활동의 약 3분의 2를 차지하므로,

segments.src: economic activity, so shifts in sentiment are watched closely as a leading indicator.
segments.tr: 심리의 변화는 선행 지표로서 면밀히 관찰됩니다.

segments.src: A sharp and sustained drop in confidence can foreshadow pullbacks in discretionary spending — on travel, dining out, and big-ticket items like cars and appliances — well before that caution shows up in official retail sales data.
segments.tr: 신뢰도가 급격하고 지속적으로 하락하면 공식 소매 판매 데이터에 그 신중함이 나타나기 훨씬 전부터 여행, 외식, 자동차 및 가전제품과 같은 고가 품목에 대한 재량적 지출이 줄어들 것임을 예고할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: It's worth noting that sentiment surveys can sometimes diverge from other economic indicators.
segments.tr: 심리 조사가 때때로 다른 경제 지표와 다를 수 있다는 점은 주목할 가치가 있습니다.

segments.src: Consumers may report feeling pessimistic even while continuing to spend, particularly if wage growth or savings cushions remain intact.
segments.tr: 특히 임금 상승이나 저축 여력이 그대로 유지되는 경우, 소비자는 계속 지출하면서도 비관적인 기분을 느낀다고 보고할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Economists often caution against reading too much into a single month's data and instead look at the trend over several readings — which is part of why the second consecutive monthly decline is drawing extra scrutiny.
segments.tr: 경제학자들은 종종 한 달치 데이터에 너무 큰 의미를 부여하지 말고 여러 번의 조사에 걸친 추세를 보라고 경고합니다. 이것이 바로 2개월 연속 월간 하락세가 추가적인 조사를 받는 이유 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 다음 단계는 무엇인가

segments.src: Markets and policymakers alike will be watching upcoming inflation reports and retail sales figures to see whether this sentiment slump is a temporary reaction to fuel-price spikes and trade headlines, or the start of a more durable shift in household psychology.
segments.tr: 시장과 정책 입안자 모두 다가오는 인플레이션 보고서와 소매 판매 수치를 지켜보며, 이번 심리 위축이 유가 급등과 무역 관련 뉴스에 대한 일시적인 반응인지, 아니면 가계 심리의 더 지속적인 변화의 시작인지 확인할 것입니다.

segments.src: The Federal Reserve, in particular, pays close attention to inflation expectations data like this because unanchored expectations can complicate efforts to bring inflation back toward target levels.
segments.tr: 특히 연방준비제도(Fed)는 이러한 인플레이션 기대치 데이터를 면밀히 주시하는데, 기대치가 고정되지 않으면 인플레이션을 목표 수준으로 되돌리려는 노력이 복잡해질 수 있기 때문입니다.

segments.src: For everyday consumers, the practical takeaway is more personal: with expectations for near-term price increases climbing, it may be worth revisiting household budgets, comparing prices before large purchases, and paying closer attention to how fuel and grocery costs are trending in the weeks ahead.
segments.tr: 일반 소비자에게 실질적인 시사점은 더 개인적입니다. 단기 물가 상승에 대한 기대치가 높아짐에 따라 가계 예산을 재검토하고, 큰 구매를 하기 전에 가격을 비교하며, 향후 몇 주 동안 연료비와 식료품 비용이 어떻게 변하는지 더 주의 깊게 살펴보는 것이 좋습니다.

segments.src: As always with economic sentiment data, the full picture will only become clear with time.
segments.tr: 경제 심리 데이터가 항상 그렇듯, 전체적인 그림은 시간이 지나야만 명확해질 것입니다.

segments.src: But for now, the numbers suggest that many Americans are bracing for a bumpier ride than they'd hoped for heading into the final stretch of the year.
segments.tr: 하지만 현재로서는 많은 미국인이 올해 마지막을 앞두고 예상했던 것보다 더 험난한 여정에 대비하고 있음을 수치가 시사하고 있습니다.

zh.title: 47.8 且仍在下跌：随着通胀担忧创下四个月新高，深入剖析消费者情绪低迷的现状

segments.src: ## A Second Straight Month of Decline
segments.tr: ## 连续第二个月下滑

segments.src: American consumers are feeling noticeably gloomier about the economy.
segments.tr: 美国消费者对经济的感受明显变得更加阴郁。

segments.src: The University of Michigan's closely watched Consumer Sentiment Index slid for a second consecutive month, landing at 47.8 — a level that sits just above the all-time lows recorded in recent history.
segments.tr: 密歇根大学备受关注的消费者信心指数连续第二个月下滑，降至 47.8 — 这一水平仅略高于近期历史记录的创纪录低点。

segments.src: The reading is more than a statistical curiosity: it's one of the earliest signals economists use to gauge how households are likely to spend, save, and borrow in the months ahead.
segments.tr: 这一数据不仅是一个统计学上的奇观：它是经济学家用以评估未来几个月家庭可能如何支出、储蓄和借贷的最早信号之一。

segments.src: Unlike hard economic data such as jobs reports or GDP figures, sentiment surveys capture something harder to quantify — how people *feel* about their financial future.
segments.tr: 与就业报告或 GDP 数字等硬性经济数据不同，信心调查捕捉到了更难定量的东西 — 即人们对其财务未来的*感受*。

segments.src: And right now, that feeling is decidedly uneasy.
segments.tr: 而眼下，那种感受显然令人不安。

segments.src: ## Inflation Expectations Jump to 4.6%
segments.tr: ## 通胀预期跳升至 4.6%

segments.src: The headline number that's drawing the most attention from economists is the survey's measure of year-ahead inflation expectations, which climbed to 4.6% — the highest level in four months.
segments.tr: 最引起经济学家关注的头条数字是该调查对未来一年通胀预期的衡量，该指标升至 4.6% — 创下四个月来的最高水平。

segments.src: That's a meaningful jump, and it matters because expectations can become self-fulfilling: when households believe prices will keep rising, they often adjust their behavior in ways that reinforce the trend, from accelerating big-ticket purchases to demanding higher wages.
segments.tr: 这是一个意义重大的跳升，它之所以重要，是因为预期可能会自我实现：当家庭相信物价将继续上涨时，他们往往会以强化这一趋势的方式调整自己的行为，从加速购买大件商品到要求更高的工资。

segments.src: Several forces appear to be feeding this anxiety:
segments.tr: 似乎有几种力量正在加剧这种焦虑：

segments.src: - **Rising fuel prices** have pushed a highly visible, frequently purchased good back into the spotlight. Gas prices tend to have an outsized psychological effect on consumers because they're updated daily on street corners across the country, making them a constant reminder of inflation even when other prices are more stable.
segments.tr: - **燃油价格上涨**将一种显眼且频繁购买的商品重新推到了聚光灯下。汽油价格往往对消费者产生巨大的心理影响，因为全国街角每天都在更新油价，使其成为即使在其他物价较为稳定时对通胀的持续提醒。

segments.src: - **Ongoing trade tensions** have added a layer of uncertainty about the cost of imported goods, components, and materials. Businesses facing higher input costs from tariffs or supply-chain friction often pass at least part of that expense on to consumers, and households appear to be pricing in that risk.
segments.tr: - **持续的贸易局势紧张**增加了进口商品、零部件和材料成本的不确定性。面临关税或供应链摩擦带来的更高投入成本的企业，往往会将至少一部分费用转嫁给消费者，而家庭似乎正在将这一风险计入价格中。

segments.src: - **Broader economic uncertainty**, including questions about the labor market and interest rates, has compounded the sense that the near-term outlook is unsettled.
segments.tr: - **更广泛的经济不确定性**，包括对劳动力市场和利率的疑问，加剧了近期前景动荡不安的感觉。

segments.src: ## Why This Reading Matters
segments.tr: ## 为什么这一数据很重要

segments.src: Consumer spending accounts for roughly two-thirds of U.S.
segments.tr: 消费者支出约占美国

segments.src: economic activity, so shifts in sentiment are watched closely as a leading indicator.
segments.tr: 经济活动的三分之二，因此情绪的转变作为先行指标受到密切关注。

segments.src: A sharp and sustained drop in confidence can foreshadow pullbacks in discretionary spending — on travel, dining out, and big-ticket items like cars and appliances — well before that caution shows up in official retail sales data.
segments.tr: 在这些谨慎态度体现在官方零售销售数据中之前很久，信心的急剧和持续下降就可能预示着可支配支出 — 如旅游、外出就餐以及汽车和家电等大件商品 — 的缩减。

segments.src: It's worth noting that sentiment surveys can sometimes diverge from other economic indicators.
segments.tr: 值得注意的是，情绪调查有时可能与其他经济指标相左。

segments.src: Consumers may report feeling pessimistic even while continuing to spend, particularly if wage growth or savings cushions remain intact.
segments.tr: 即使在继续消费的同时，消费者也可能报告感到悲观，特别是如果工资增长或储蓄缓冲依然完好的话。

segments.src: Economists often caution against reading too much into a single month's data and instead look at the trend over several readings — which is part of why the second consecutive monthly decline is drawing extra scrutiny.
segments.tr: 经济学家经常警告不要过度解读单月的数据，而是要看跨越几次读取的趋势 — 这也是连续第二个月下滑招致额外审查的部分原因。

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来的走向

segments.src: Markets and policymakers alike will be watching upcoming inflation reports and retail sales figures to see whether this sentiment slump is a temporary reaction to fuel-price spikes and trade headlines, or the start of a more durable shift in household psychology.
segments.tr: 市场和政策制定者都将关注即将发布的通胀报告和零售销售数据，以观察这种情绪低迷是对燃油价格飙升和贸易头条新闻的短暂反应，还是家庭心理更持久转变的开始。

segments.src: The Federal Reserve, in particular, pays close attention to inflation expectations data like this because unanchored expectations can complicate efforts to bring inflation back toward target levels.
segments.tr: 美联储尤为密切地关注像这样的通胀预期数据，因为失锚的预期会使将通胀带回目标水平的努力变得更加复杂。

segments.src: For everyday consumers, the practical takeaway is more personal: with expectations for near-term price increases climbing, it may be worth revisiting household budgets, comparing prices before large purchases, and paying closer attention to how fuel and grocery costs are trending in the weeks ahead.
segments.tr: 对于普通消费者来说，切实可行的新启示则更为贴近个人：随着对近期物价上涨的预期上升，重温家庭预算、在进行大额购买前比较价格，并在未来几周更密切地关注燃油和食品杂货成本的走势，可能是值得的。

segments.src: As always with economic sentiment data, the full picture will only become clear with time.
segments.tr: 一如既往，对于经济情绪数据而言，全貌只有随着时间的推移才会变得清晰。

segments.src: But for now, the numbers suggest that many Americans are bracing for a bumpier ride than they'd hoped for heading into the final stretch of the year.
segments.tr: 但就目前而言，这些数字表明，许多美国人正在为进入今年最后阶段比预期更加坎坷的旅程做准备。

segments.tr: मुख्य आंकड़ा जो अर्थशास्त्रियों का सबसे अधिक ध्यान आकर्षित कर रहा है, वह है सर्वेक्षण का आगामी वर्ष की मुद्रास्फीति की उम्मीदों का पैमाना, जो बढ़कर 4.6% हो गया — जो चार महीनों में सबसे उच्चतम स्तर है।

segments.src: That's a meaningful jump, and it matters because expectations can become self-fulfilling: when households believe prices will keep rising, they often adjust their behavior in ways that reinforce the trend, from accelerating big-ticket purchases to demanding higher wages.
segments.tr: यह एक महत्वपूर्ण उछाल है, और यह मायने रखता है क्योंकि उम्मीदें स्वतः पूर्ण होने वाली बन सकती हैं: जब परिवारों को लगता है कि कीमतें बढ़ती रहेंगी, तो वे अक्सर अपने व्यवहार को इस तरह से समायोजित करते हैं जो इस प्रवृत्ति को सुदृढ़ करता है, जैसे कि बड़ी खरीदारी में तेजी लाना या अधिक वेतन की मांग करना।

segments.src: Several forces appear to be feeding this anxiety:

segments.src: - **Rising fuel prices** have pushed a highly visible, frequently purchased good back into the spotlight. Gas prices tend to have an outsized psychological effect on consumers because they're updated daily on street corners across the country, making them a constant reminder of inflation even when other prices are more stable.
segments.tr: - **ईंधन की बढ़ती कीमतों** ने एक अत्यधिक दृश्यमान, बार-बार खरीदी जाने वाली वस्तु को फिर से सुर्खियों में ला दिया है। गैस की कीमतों का उपभोक्ताओं पर अत्यधिक मनोवैज्ञानिक प्रभाव पड़ता है क्योंकि वे देश भर के नुक्कड़ों पर दैनिक रूप से अपडेट की जाती हैं, जिससे वे मुद्रास्फीति की लगातार याद दिलाती रहती हैं, भले ही अन्य कीमतें अधिक स्थिर हों।

segments.src: - **Ongoing trade tensions** have added a layer of uncertainty about the cost of imported goods, components, and materials. Businesses facing higher input costs from tariffs or supply-chain friction often pass at least part of that expense on to consumers, and households appear to be pricing in that risk.
segments.tr: - **चल रहे व्यापारिक तनाव** ने आयातित वस्तुओं, घटकों और सामग्रियों की लागत के बारे में अनिश्चितता की एक परत जोड़ दी है। टैरिफ या आपूर्ति-श्रृंखला के घर्षण से उच्च इनपुट लागतों का सामना करने वाले व्यवसाय अक्सर उस खर्च का कम से कम हिस्सा उपभोक्ताओं पर डालते हैं, और परिवार उस जोखिम को पहले से ही आंक रहे हैं।

segments.src: - **Broader economic uncertainty**, including questions about the labor market and interest rates, has compounded the sense that the near-term outlook is unsettled.
segments.tr: - **व्यापक आर्थिक अनिश्चितता**, जिसमें श्रम बाजार और ब्याज दरों के बारे में प्रश्न शामिल हैं, ने इस भावना को और बढ़ा दिया है कि निकट अवधि का दृष्टिकोण अस्थिर है।

segments.tr: ## आगे क्या होगा

segments.src: Markets and policymakers alike will be watching upcoming inflation reports and retail sales figures to see whether this sentiment slump is a temporary reaction to fuel-price spikes and trade headlines, or the start of a more durable shift in household psychology.
segments.tr: बाजार और नीति निर्माता दोनों ही आगामी मुद्रास्फीति रिपोर्टों और खुदरा बिक्री के आंकड़ों पर नजर रखेंगे ताकि यह देखा जा सके कि भावना में यह गिरावट ईंधन की कीमतों में उछाल और व्यापारिक सुर्खियों पर एक अस्थायी प्रतिक्रिया है, या घरेलू मनोविज्ञान में अधिक स्थायी बदलाव की शुरुआत है।

segments.tr: फेडरल रिजर्व, विशेष रूप से, इस तरह के मुद्रास्फीति की उम्मीदों के आंकड़ों पर बारीकी से ध्यान देता है क्योंकि अनियंत्रित उम्मीदें मुद्रास्फीति को वापस लक्ष्य स्तरों पर लाने के प्रयासों को जटिल बना सकती हैं।

segments.src: For everyday consumers, the practical takeaway is more personal: with expectations for near-term price increases climbing, it may be worth revisiting household budgets, comparing prices before large purchases, and paying closer attention to how fuel and grocery costs are trending in the weeks ahead.
segments.tr: आम उपभोक्ताओं के लिए, व्यावहारिक निष्कर्ष अधिक व्यक्तिगत है: निकट अवधि में कीमतों में वृद्धि की उम्मीदों के बढ़ने के साथ, घरेलू बजट पर फिर से विचार करना, बड़ी खरीदारी से पहले कीमतों की तुलना करना और आने वाले हफ्तों में ईंधन और किराने की लागत के रुझान पर अधिक ध्यान देना उचित हो सकता है।

segments.src: As always with economic sentiment data, the full picture will only become clear with time.

segments.src: But for now, the numbers suggest that many Americans are bracing for a bumpier ride than they'd hoped for heading into the final stretch of the year.
segments.tr: लेकिन फिलहाल, आंकड़े बताते हैं कि कई अमेरिकी वर्ष के अंतिम पड़ाव में अपनी उम्मीद से अधिक कठिन सफर के लिए खुद को तैयार कर रहे हैं।

fr.title: 47,8 et en baisse : plongée dans le recul de la confiance des consommateurs alors que les craintes liées à l'inflation atteignent un sommet en quatre mois

segments.src: ## A Second Straight Month of Decline
segments.tr: ## Un deuxième mois consécutif de baisse

segments.src: American consumers are feeling noticeably gloomier about the economy.
segments.tr: Les consommateurs américains se sentent nettement plus pessimistes quant à l'économie.

segments.src: The University of Michigan's closely watched Consumer Sentiment Index slid for a second consecutive month, landing at 47.8 — a level that sits just above the all-time lows recorded in recent history.
segments.tr: L'indice de confiance des consommateurs de l'Université du Michigan, très suivi, a reculé pour le deuxième mois consécutif, s'établissant à 47,8 — un niveau qui se situe juste au-dessus des plus bas historiques enregistrés récemment.

segments.src: The reading is more than a statistical curiosity: it's one of the earliest signals economists use to gauge how households are likely to spend, save, and borrow in the months ahead.
segments.tr: Ce chiffre est plus qu'une simple curiosité statistique : c'est l'un des premiers signaux utilisés par les économistes pour évaluer la manière dont les ménages sont susceptibles de dépenser, d'épargner et d'emprunter dans les mois à venir.

segments.src: Unlike hard economic data such as jobs reports or GDP figures, sentiment surveys capture something harder to quantify — how people *feel* about their financial future.
segments.tr: Contrairement aux données économiques concrètes telles que les rapports sur l'emploi ou les chiffres du PIB, les enquêtes de confiance capturent quelque chose de plus difficile à quantifier — ce que les gens *ressentent* à propos de leur avenir financier.

segments.src: And right now, that feeling is decidedly uneasy.
segments.tr: Et en ce moment, ce sentiment est résolument inquiet.

segments.src: ## Inflation Expectations Jump to 4.6%
segments.tr: ## Les anticipations d'inflation grimpent à 4,6 %

segments.src: The headline number that's drawing the most attention from economists is the survey's measure of year-ahead inflation expectations, which climbed to 4.6% — the highest level in four months.
segments.tr: Le chiffre principal qui attire le plus l'attention des économistes est la mesure des anticipations d'inflation à un an de l'enquête, qui a grimpé à 4,6 % — le niveau le plus élevé en quatre mois.

segments.src: That's a meaningful jump, and it matters because expectations can become self-fulfilling: when households believe prices will keep rising, they often adjust their behavior in ways that reinforce the trend, from accelerating big-ticket purchases to demanding higher wages.
segments.tr: Il s'agit d'un bond significatif, et cela compte car les anticipations peuvent devenir auto-réalisatrices : lorsque les ménages croient que les prix vont continuer à augmenter, ils ajustent souvent leur comportement de manière à renforcer la tendance, en accélérant les achats importants ou en exigeant des salaires plus élevés.

segments.src: Several forces appear to be feeding this anxiety:
segments.tr: Plusieurs forces semblent alimenter cette anxiété :

segments.src: - **Rising fuel prices** have pushed a highly visible, frequently purchased good back into the spotlight. Gas prices tend to have an outsized psychological effect on consumers because they're updated daily on street corners across the country, making them a constant reminder of inflation even when other prices are more stable.
segments.tr: - **La hausse des prix du carburant** a remis sous les projecteurs un bien très visible et fréquemment acheté. Les prix de l'essence ont tendance à avoir un effet psychologique démesuré sur les consommateurs car ils sont mis à jour quotidiennement aux coins des rues à travers le pays, ce qui en fait un rappel constant de l'inflation même lorsque les autres prix sont plus stables.

segments.src: - **Ongoing trade tensions** have added a layer of uncertainty about the cost of imported goods, components, and materials. Businesses facing higher input costs from tariffs or supply-chain friction often pass at least part of that expense on to consumers, and households appear to be pricing in that risk.
segments.tr: - **Les tensions commerciales persistantes** ont ajouté une couche d'incertitude sur le coût des biens importés, des composants et des matériaux. Les entreprises confrontées à des coûts d'intrants plus élevés en raison des tarifs douaniers ou des frictions dans la chaîne d'approvisionnement répercutent souvent au moins une partie de ces dépenses sur les consommateurs, et les ménages semblent intégrer ce risque dans leurs calculs.

segments.src: - **Broader economic uncertainty**, including questions about the labor market and interest rates, has compounded the sense that the near-term outlook is unsettled.
segments.tr: - **L'incertitude économique plus large**, y compris les questions sur le marché du travail et les taux d'intérêt, a aggravé le sentiment que les perspectives à court terme sont instables.

segments.tr: ## Pourquoi ce chiffre est important

segments.src: Consumer spending accounts for roughly two-thirds of U.S.

segments.tr: Une baisse marquée et soutenue de la confiance peut présager des réductions des dépenses discrétionnaires — pour les voyages, les sorties au restaurant et les achats importants comme les voitures et les appareils électroménagers — bien avant que cette prudence n'apparaisse dans les données officielles sur les ventes au détail.

segments.tr: Il convient de noter que les enquêtes de confiance peuvent parfois diverger d'autres indicateurs économiques.

segments.src: Economists often caution against reading too much into a single month's data and instead look at the trend over several readings — which is part of why the second consecutive monthly decline is drawing extra scrutiny.
segments.tr: Les économistes mettent souvent en garde contre le fait de trop interpréter les données d'un seul mois et préfèrent examiner la tendance sur plusieurs relevés — ce qui explique en partie pourquoi la deuxième baisse mensuelle consécutive fait l'objet d'un examen plus approfondi.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Que se passera-t-il ensuite

segments.src: Markets and policymakers alike will be watching upcoming inflation reports and retail sales figures to see whether this sentiment slump is a temporary reaction to fuel-price spikes and trade headlines, or the start of a more durable shift in household psychology.
segments.tr: Les marchés comme les décideurs politiques surveilleront les prochains rapports sur l'inflation et les chiffres des ventes au détail pour voir si ce recul de la confiance est une réaction temporaire aux pics des prix du carburant et aux gros titres sur le commerce, ou le début d'un changement plus durable dans la psychologie des ménages.

segments.tr: La Réserve fédérale, en particulier, prête une attention particulière aux données sur les anticipations d'inflation comme celles-ci, car des anticipations non ancrées peuvent compliquer les efforts pour ramener l'inflation vers les niveaux cibles.

segments.src: For everyday consumers, the practical takeaway is more personal: with expectations for near-term price increases climbing, it may be worth revisiting household budgets, comparing prices before large purchases, and paying closer attention to how fuel and grocery costs are trending in the weeks ahead.
segments.tr: Pour les consommateurs ordinaires, la leçon pratique est plus personnelle : avec la hausse des anticipations de prix à court terme, il peut être utile de revoir les budgets des ménages, de comparer les prix avant les achats importants et de prêter une attention plus étroite à l'évolution des coûts du carburant et de l'épicerie dans les semaines à venir.

segments.src: As always with economic sentiment data, the full picture will only become clear with time.
segments.tr: Comme toujours avec les données sur le sentiment économique, l'image complète ne deviendra claire qu'avec le temps.

segments.src: But for now, the numbers suggest that many Americans are bracing for a bumpier ride than they'd hoped for heading into the final stretch of the year.
segments.tr: Mais pour l'instant, les chiffres suggèrent que de nombreux Américains se préparent à un parcours plus cahoteux qu'ils ne l'espéraient à l'approche de la dernière ligne droite de l'année.

de.title: 47.8 und fallend: Einblicke in den Einbruch der Verbraucherstimmung, da Inflationsängste ein Viermonatshoch erreichen

segments.src: ## A Second Straight Month of Decline

segments.src: American consumers are feeling noticeably gloomier about the economy.

segments.src: The University of Michigan's closely watched Consumer Sentiment Index slid for a second consecutive month, landing at 47.8 — a level that sits just above the all-time lows recorded in recent history.
segments.tr: Der viel beachtete Index der Verbraucherstimmung der University of Michigan sank im zweiten Monat in Folge und landete bei 47.8 – ein Wert, der knapp über den Allzeittiefs der jüngeren Geschichte liegt.

segments.src: The reading is more than a statistical curiosity: it's one of the earliest signals economists use to gauge how households are likely to spend, save, and borrow in the months ahead.
segments.tr: Dieser Wert ist mehr als eine statistische Kuriosität: Er ist eines der frühesten Signale, die Ökonomen nutzen, um einzuschätzen, wie Haushalte in den kommenden Monaten voraussichtlich ausgeben, sparen und sich verschulden werden.

segments.src: Unlike hard economic data such as jobs reports or GDP figures, sentiment surveys capture something harder to quantify — how people *feel* about their financial future.
segments.tr: Im Gegensatz zu harten Wirtschaftsdaten wie Arbeitsmarktberichten oder BIP-Zahlen erfassen Stimmungsbefragungen etwas, das schwerer zu quantifizieren ist – wie sich die Menschen hinsichtlich ihrer finanziellen Zukunft *fühlen*.

segments.tr: Die Kennzahl, die von Ökonomen die meiste Aufmerksamkeit erhält, ist das Maß der Umfrage für die einjährigen Inflationserwartungen, das auf 4.6% kletterte – den höchsten Stand seit vier Monaten.

segments.src: That's a meaningful jump, and it matters because expectations can become self-fulfilling: when households believe prices will keep rising, they often adjust their behavior in ways that reinforce the trend, from accelerating big-ticket purchases to demanding higher wages.
segments.tr: Das ist ein bedeutsamer Sprung, und er ist wichtig, weil Erwartungen selbsterfüllend werden können: Wenn Haushalte glauben, dass die Preise weiter steigen werden, passen sie ihr Verhalten oft auf Weisen an, die den Trend verstärken, von der Vorziehung großer Anschaffungen bis hin zur Forderung nach höheren Löhnen.

segments.src: - **Ongoing trade tensions** have added a layer of uncertainty about the cost of imported goods, components, and materials. Businesses facing higher input costs from tariffs or supply-chain friction often pass at least part of that expense on to consumers, and households appear to be pricing in that risk.
segments.tr: - **Căng thẳng thương mại đang diễn ra** đã tạo thêm một tầng bất định về chi phí của hàng hóa nhập khẩu, linh kiện và nguyên vật liệu. Các doanh nghiệp đối mặt với chi phí đầu vào cao hơn từ thuế quan hoặc ma sát chuỗi cung ứng thường chuyển ít nhất một phần chi phí đó sang người tiêu dùng, và các hộ gia đình dường như đang tính toán rủi ro đó.

segments.src: - **Broader economic uncertainty**, including questions about the labor market and interest rates, has compounded the sense that the near-term outlook is unsettled.
segments.tr: - **Bất định kinh tế rộng lớn hơn**, bao gồm các câu hỏi về thị trường lao động và lãi suất, đã làm trầm trọng thêm cảm giác rằng triển vọng ngắn hạn là chưa ổn định.

segments.src: ## Why This Reading Matters
segments.tr: ## Tại sao chỉ số này lại quan trọng

segments.src: Consumer spending accounts for roughly two-thirds of U.S.
segments.tr: Chi tiêu tiêu dùng chiếm khoảng 2/3 tổng sản phẩm của Mỹ.

segments.src: economic activity, so shifts in sentiment are watched closely as a leading indicator.
segments.tr: hoạt động kinh tế, vì vậy sự dịch chuyển trong niềm tin được theo dõi chặt chẽ như một chỉ báo dẫn dắt.

segments.src: A sharp and sustained drop in confidence can foreshadow pullbacks in discretionary spending — on travel, dining out, and big-ticket items like cars and appliances — well before that caution shows up in official retail sales data.
segments.tr: Sự sụt giảm mạnh và duy trì của lòng tin có thể báo trước sự chậm lại trong chi tiêu tùy ý — về du lịch, ăn uống ngoài hàng, và các mặt hàng giá trị lớn như ô tô và thiết bị gia dụng — rất lâu trước khi sự thận trọng đó xuất hiện trong dữ liệu bán lẻ chính thức.

segments.src: It's worth noting that sentiment surveys can sometimes diverge from other economic indicators.
segments.tr: Cần lưu ý rằng các khảo sát niềm tin đôi khi có thể đi chệch khỏi các chỉ báo kinh tế khác.

segments.src: Consumers may report feeling pessimistic even while continuing to spend, particularly if wage growth or savings cushions remain intact.
segments.tr: Người tiêu dùng có thể báo cáo cảm thấy bi quan ngay cả khi tiếp tục chi tiêu, đặc biệt nếu tăng trưởng tiền lương hoặc quỹ tiết kiệm vẫn còn nguyên vẹn.

segments.src: Economists often caution against reading too much into a single month's data and instead look at the trend over several readings — which is part of why the second consecutive monthly decline is drawing extra scrutiny.
segments.tr: Các nhà kinh tế thường cảnh báo không nên đọc quá nhiều vào dữ liệu của một tháng đơn lẻ mà thay vào đó hãy nhìn vào xu hướng qua nhiều lần khảo sát — đó là một phần lý do tại sao sự sụt giảm hàng tháng lần thứ hai liên tiếp đang thu hút sự giám sát kỹ lưỡng hơn.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Điều gì xảy ra tiếp theo

segments.src: Markets and policymakers alike will be watching upcoming inflation reports and retail sales figures to see whether this sentiment slump is a temporary reaction to fuel-price spikes and trade headlines, or the start of a more durable shift in household psychology.
segments.tr: Cả thị trường và các nhà hoạch định chính sách đều sẽ theo dõi các báo cáo lạm phát và số liệu bán lẻ sắp tới để xem liệu sự suy giảm niềm tin này là phản ứng tạm thời đối với việc tăng giá nhiên liệu và các tiêu đề thương mại, hay là khởi đầu của một sự dịch chuyển bền vững hơn trong tâm lý hộ gia đình.

segments.src: The Federal Reserve, in particular, pays close attention to inflation expectations data like this because unanchored expectations can complicate efforts to bring inflation back toward target levels.
segments.tr: Cục Dự trữ Liên bang, cụ thể, đặc biệt chú ý đến dữ liệu kỳ vọng lạm phát như thế này bởi vì các kỳ vọng không được neo giữ có thể làm phức tạp thêm nỗ lực đưa lạm phát trở lại mức mục tiêu.

segments.src: For everyday consumers, the practical takeaway is more personal: with expectations for near-term price increases climbing, it may be worth revisiting household budgets, comparing prices before large purchases, and paying closer attention to how fuel and grocery costs are trending in the weeks ahead.
segments.tr: Đối với người tiêu dùng hàng ngày, bài học thực tế mang tính cá nhân hơn: với kỳ vọng tăng giá trong ngắn hạn đang leo thang, có thể đáng để xem xét lại ngân sách hộ gia đình, so sánh giá trước các giao dịch mua lớn, và chú ý hơn đến xu hướng chi phí nhiên liệu và hàng tạp hóa trong những tuần tới.

segments.src: As always with economic sentiment data, the full picture will only become clear with time.
segments.tr: Như mọi khi với dữ liệu tâm lý kinh tế, toàn bộ bức tranh sẽ chỉ trở nên rõ ràng theo thời gian.

segments.src: But for now, the numbers suggest that many Americans are bracing for a bumpier ride than they'd hoped for heading into the final stretch of the year.
segments.tr: Nhưng hiện tại, các con số cho thấy nhiều người Mỹ đang chuẩn bị cho một chặng đường gập ghềnh hơn họ mong đợi khi bước vào giai đoạn cuối cùng của năm.
